trips: select t.{{id:trips}} as id, t.name, t.destination, t.purpose, t.status, t.status__label as status_label, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.est_airfare, t.est_hotel, t.est_meals, t.est_other, t.est_total, t.owner, t.owner__label as traveller, t.approver, t.approver__label as approver_name, t.approved_date, t.travel_poc__label as poc, t.outbound_from, t.outbound_to, t.outbound_at, t.outbound_flight, t.return_from, t.return_to, t.return_at, t.return_flight, t.hotel_name, t.hotel_address, t.check_in, t.check_out, (select e.name from associations a join marketing_events e on e.pc_0060_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'trips' and a.other_object = 'marketing_events' and a.record_id = t.{{id:trips}} order by e.name limit 1) as event, (select sum(x.amount) from associations a join expenses x on x.{{id:expenses}} = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'trips' and a.other_object = 'expenses' and a.record_id = t.{{id:trips}}) as spent from trips t order by t.start_date desc nulls last, t.name
expenses: select x.{{id:expenses}} as id, x.name, x.amount, x.expense_date, x.category, x.category__label as category_label, x.vendor, x.notes, x.receipt, x.owner__label as spent_by, (select a.other_record_id from associations a where a.object = 'expenses' and a.other_object = 'trips' and a.record_id = x.{{id:expenses}} limit 1) as trip_id from expenses x order by x.expense_date desc nulls last, x.created_at desc limit 2000
categories: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:expenses}}' and property = 'category' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
trip_statuses: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:trips}}' and property = 'status' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
